game.title: Kansas City Chiefs at Miami Dolphins

lede: Kansas City Chiefs carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#20 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Miami Dolphins +0.9 with a fair total of 41.4 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Miami Dolphins run offence vs Kansas City Chiefs run defence, which sits −0.104 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Kansas City Chiefs and Miami Dolphins have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
